Description: Chronoverse AWS newsletter. Email and scheduling disabled by default.

SecretsArn.Description: Existing dedicated Secrets Manager secret ARN: capabilityKey, websiteKey, optional original legacyV1Key

IdentityArn.Description: Existing verified SES domain identity ARN; not created or modified by this stack

PostalAddress.Description: Approved lawful public business mailing address only

AlarmTopicArn.Description: Optional existing operational SNS topic; stack creates no email subscription

PublicOrigin.Description: Separately approved HTTPS public API origin, without trailing slash or path. Empty keeps enrollment unavailable; no DNS/certificate is created.

ContentBucket.Description: Existing private versioned Stockholm content bucket. Artifact bucket reuse requires separate isolation/retention/policy approval.

ContentManifestKey.Description: Exact approved JSON manifest object key; not an S3 prefix wildcard.

Topics.Description: Up to ten published research articles weekly

Properties.AlarmDescription: Regional Lambda errors/throttles include unrelated functions. Inspect Lambda metrics and newsletter logs to locate failures.
Newsletter safety fault: inspect signal in logs for held send, API/provider/queue failure, throttling, expired campaign, hard bounce or complaint.
Queue or contact-stream backlog at least one hour old. Inspect each source; no claim resets or suppression deletion.
